cases.source_boundary: Original HTTP/HTTPS/FTP schema validator calls re.lastIndex = pos; re.exec(text), with pos immediately after the schema colon. testSchemaAt first caps the subject at pos+maxLength. This case measures the HTTP link-tail regexp at a known candidate offset on the already-bounded original subject, including //host and path. Schema discovery, normalization, extraction of whole URLs and fuzzy links are outside this boundary.
